subject: Phased MAP & credit request for OpsLynx — timeline and signoff needed
messages:
From: Gregor Klein <gregor.klein@opslynx.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Phased MAP proposal and request for onboarding credit

Hi David,

Thanks for the call today — really appreciate the time. Attached is a compact MAP draft (OpsLynx_PHASED_MAP_v2.pdf) that lays out a two-phase evaluation and then a commercial ramp through Q4. High level: a 6-week eval (phase 1) then a 6-month pilot to production ramp (phase 2) tied to token-based commits and a usage corridor.

Two asks from our side: 1) a $60k onboarding credit to offset conversion effort and 2) a 30% discount on committed usage for the first three months of phase 2. Both items are contingent on hitting the MAP milestone schedule (test pass + integration signoff).

We need a proposal back with pricing, credit mechanics, and target close date by next Thursday (16 Sep) so we can route internally. I copied Samira (ops) and our legal contact for visibility.

Best,
Gregor
Senior GTM Lead
OpsLynx

Attachments: OpsLynx_PHASED_MAP_v2.pdf, OpsLynx_Q3_forecast.xlsx
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gregor Klein <gregor.klein@opslynx.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@opslynx.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Phased MAP proposal and request for onboarding credit

Gregor —

Appreciate the clean MAP doc and the clear timeline. We can support a phased approach. Two quick clarifications before we put an internal ask together:

- Is the $60k credit intended to be applied as an upfront invoice credit against month 1 of phase 2, or as a usage rebate over the first quarter?
- The 30% discount — is that on list price for all tokens or only the committed corridor (i.e., tiered over-usage rates)?

If you can confirm those by Monday I’ll draft a formal proposal + a conditional credit schedule and loop in the commercial approvals chain. Tentative internal ETA: I can get a first internal draft to you by Tue 14 Sep.

Thanks —
David Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: OpsLynx MAP — credit + discount ask (need signoff path)

Team —

OpsLynx is requesting a $60k onboarding credit and a 30% discount for the first three months of phase 2 contingent on MAP milestones. They are a strategic prospect (target ARR $1.2M year1 if ramp hits). Key timeline: they want formal pricing and mechanics by 16 Sep so they can route internally.

Attached: OpsLynx_PHASED_MAP_v2.pdf and their Q3 forecast. My recommendation:
- Approve up to $50k onboarding credit without exec signoff (applied as invoice credit month1 of phase 2)
- Approve a conditional 25% discount on committed corridor for months 1–3 of phase 2 (anything >25% requires VP/CFO escalation)

If you’re okay with the above I’ll draft the term sheet. If anyone feels we need to be more aggressive to win (we may need to get to 30–35%), flag now — but that will need Laura and Markus to sign off.

Thanks —
David
Enterprise Sales

Attachments referenced: OpsLynx_PHASED_MAP_v2.pdf, OpsLynx_Q3_forecast.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: OpsLynx MAP — credit + discount ask (need signoff path)

David/Marissa —

Thanks for the write-up. I concur with the conservative path: approve $50k credit + 25% conditional discount without exec loop. OpsLynx is important but we should preserve margin until integration proves value.

Laura — can you confirm whether $50k+$50–70k in total credit/discount exposure needs CFO or CEO approval? If this stays in the $50k credit + 25% discount band, we can approve from Sales. Anything beyond (e.g., $60k credit + 30% discount) needs formal CFO/CEO sign-off prior to contract.

If Laura confirms, I’ll ask David to send the draft term sheet for legal to redline.

- Aditya
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Internal: OpsLynx MAP — credit + discount ask (need signoff path)

Team —

Confirmed: Finance will approve up to $50k onboarding credit + up to a 25% promotional discount on the committed corridor for months 1–3 of phase 2 without CEO involvement. Any combination where our total committed exposure (credit + estimated promotional uplift) exceeds $75k requires CEO signoff (Markus).

Action items for David/Marissa:
1) Please send the draft term sheet that documents credit application (invoice credit month1 vs. quarterly rebate) and milestone gating language.
2) Show the conservative lift estimate so Finance can calculate exposure in the approval memo.
3) If OpsLynx still needs $60k/30%, we’ll prepare an approval memo and route to Markus for final sign.

I’m copying Markus so he’s aware of the potential escalation.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: term_sheet_redline.pdf (to be prepared once draft is received)
